Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the supply of water by public utility districts bordered by the Columbia river to be used in pumped storage projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the supply of water by public utility districtsbordered by the Columbia river to be used in pumped storage projects;and adding a new section to chapter 54.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 54.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding any other provision of this chapter to thecontrary, a public utility district bordered by the Columbia river maysupply any water, as authorized by a water right under its control, tobe used in a pumped storage generating facility to any entity thatsells electric energy or water, directly or indirectly, to the public,and contracts therefor must extend over the period of years and containthe terms and conditions for the sale thereof as the commission of thepublic utility district elects. Such a contract may only be madepursuant to resolution of the commission authorizing such a contract,and the resolution must be introduced at a meeting of the commission atleast ten days prior to the date of the adoption of the resolution. p. 1 SSB 6044However, the commission shall first make adequate provision for theneeds of the public utility district, both actual and prospective.
